description:
Create a new knowledge list with a typed schema.
Idempotent on key collision — returns the existing list with a warning instead of erroring, so AI agents can safely re-run setup steps.
Use this before inserting rows to ensure the list schema exists.
Returns: { listKey, fieldCount, kgSyncEnabled, alreadyExisted? }.

Requires write access when connected with OAuth.

entityConfig.description: Entity resolution config for entity-type lists.

fields.description: Field definitions for the list schema. Empty list creates a schema-less list.

id.description: Internal field identifier used in schema operations such as removeFieldIds (snake_case recommended). Not used as a rowData key.

label.description: Human-friendly display label shown in the UI. Defaults to name if omitted.

name.description: Storage and query key — rowData is keyed by this value (e.g. rowData[field.name]). Must be unique within the list.

type.description: Field type: text | number | date | boolean | url | email | select

key.description: Unique list key (e.g. "prospects", "investors"). Used as the stable identifier — cannot be changed later.

listCategory.description: Category: "data" (plain storage, default) or "entity" (graph-connected, supports KG edges).

name.description: Human-readable display name for the list.

syncToKg.description: When true, rows are synced to the Knowledge Graph for semantic search and edge traversal. Default: false.

userKeyField.description: Which field name to use as the deterministic userKey for upsert dedup. When set, kg.upsert-rows will automatically derive userKey = row[userKeyField] for incoming rows, enabling O(1) cross-run dedup without the caller needing to supply userKey explicitly. Pick a stable field (e.g. "affinity_person_id", "email", "domain"). Omit for lists where rows are always supplied with explicit userKeys or where dedup is not needed.

name: create_knowledge_list
